app.title: SVG Multicolor

opt.max_colors_hint: How many filaments your printer can use. 0 = no limit.
opt.merge_hint: 0 = off. Higher values join colors that look alike (ΔE).
base.hint: 0 mm = no base. With a base, the colors sit on top of it (new 3MF only).
adv.hint: A smaller precision keeps more detail and makes bigger files.
adv.min_detail_hint: Lines thinner than the nozzle cannot be printed; they are handed to the neighboring color. 0 = off; about half the nozzle diameter works well.
